title: Commit messages
body: The sparkle button in the Source Control commit box drafts a message from your changes. Edit it before committing. Team style can go in github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGeneration.instructions.

title: Terminal inline chat
body: ⌘I / Ctrl+I in the terminal turns a description into a shell command. ⌘Enter / Ctrl+Enter runs it; ⌥Enter / Alt+Enter inserts it so you can check it first.

title: Fix a failed command
body: After a command fails, a sparkle Quick Fix appears in the terminal gutter. One click, with only that failure as context.

title: Smart actions
body: Right-click in the editor and choose Generate Code for Review, Fix, Generate Docs or Generate Tests, without writing a prompt.

title: Copilot code review on PRs
body: Add Copilot as a reviewer on a GitHub pull request. It leaves comments, follows your instruction files, doesn’t count as an approval, and uses AI credits.

title: Copilot cloud agent
body: Assign a GitHub issue to Copilot, or delegate from VS Code chat, and it works in the cloud and opens a pull request for your review. Best for small, well-described issues.
